meta.purpose: 100 things that happen every day, everywhere. Structural substrate for the memetic-overlap timeline. Each constant is a vertical thread; the user's stream transcripts (@wubustreams) overlap onto them — the Cambrian explosion of memetic overlap information.
meta.usage: organize_constants.py --match '<transcript>' tags a stream moment to constants; --stream gaming_stream emits overlap entries for the calendar.
